title: Gender Bias in Text-to-Video Generation Models: A case study of Sora

bias_targets.methodology: Frequency analysis of 120 videos generated by the Sora model using 12 gender-neutral prompts across categories of Appearance, Behavior, and Occupation to count associations with male or female genders.
Qualitative observation of generated videos identifying stereotypes, such as associating frailty with older individuals and shyness with younger individuals.

Visual analysis of generated videos identifying stereotypical settings or attire associated with certain traits, such as confident individuals always appearing in formal attire or rational individuals always studying/working.
